content_html:
AIbase Report A bar in Beijing is redefining the "AI + life" scenario in a unique way. From now on, customers who consume at AGI Bar can connect to the store's Wi-Fi and get a free API Token for DeepSeek V4Flash, with unlimited usage during their stay at the bar.

Zero-Barrier Access to AI Capabilities

Users need no subscription or additional payment. They just need to enter the provided Base URL and API Key into clients like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cherry Studio, or other OpenAI API-compatible platforms, and they can directly call the DeepSeek V4Flash model for inference.

According to the introduction, the bar will later integrate more advanced models, further enriching the AI experience for customers. This new "drink and use AI" model turns AI services that used to require registration and payment into a basic service like Wi-Fi, which is available immediately upon connection.

From a Consumption Scene to an AI Gathering Place

AGI Bar not only offers drinks and space but has also become an exchange hub for AI professionals in China. Many industry insiders regard it as an important offline AI community node. Previously, David Holz, CEO of Midjourney, visited this bar during his visit to China.

The founder of the bar has long been engaged in AI industry entrepreneurship, combining physical space with cutting-edge technology to explore the possibilities of AI in daily life.

Signs of AI Infrastructure

This move is seen as an important trend in AI development. In the past, AI services were always closely tied to account registration, subscription fees, and token consumption; now, AI inference capabilities are gradually becoming infrastructure, becoming a standard service in offline commercial spaces, like water, electricity, and Wi-Fi.

Industry observers believe that as the cost of large model inference continues to decline, innovative approaches like "giving away AI computing power" may appear in more cafes, bars, and shared spaces. In the future, customers may naturally gain powerful AI productivity support while enjoying physical services.

content_html_zh:
AIbase报道 北京的一家酒吧正在以独特的方式重新定义“AI+生活”场景。 即日起，在AGI Bar消费的顾客可以连接到商店的Wi-Fi并获得DeepSeek V4Flash的免费API Token，在酒吧逗留期间无限使用。

零门槛获取AI能力

用户无需订阅或额外付费。 他们只需将提供的Base URL和API Key输入Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cherry Studio或其他OpenAI API兼容平台等客户端，就可以直接调用DeepSeek V4Flash模型进行推理。

据介绍，该酒吧后续还将集成更多先进模型，进一步丰富顾客的AI体验。 这种“喝了就用AI”的新模式，将原来需要注册、付费的AI服务变成了像Wi-Fi一样，一连接就可以使用的基础服务。

从消费场景到AI聚集地

AGI Bar不仅提供饮料和空间，而且已成为中国人工智能专业人士的交流中心。 不少业内人士将其视为重要的线下AI社区节点。 此前，Midjourney首席执行官David Holz在访华期间曾到访过这家酒吧。

酒吧创始人长期从事AI行业创业，将物理空间与前沿科技相结合，探索AI在日常生活中的可能性。

人工智能基础设施的迹象

此举被视为人工智能发展的重要趋势。 过去，AI服务总是与账户注册、订阅费、代币消费紧密联系在一起；现在，AI推理能力正逐渐成为基础设施，成为线下商业空间的标配服务，就像水、电、Wi-Fi一样。

行业观察人士认为，随着大型模型推理成本的不断下降，像“赠送AI算力”这样的创新方式可能会出现在更多的咖啡馆、酒吧和共享空间中。 未来，客户在享受实体服务的同时，自然也能获得强大的AI生产力支持。
